summary: Ennis, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting quarterly results and a dividend increase. The board declared a 5.0% raise in the quarterly cash dividend from $0.25 to $0.2625 per share, payable November 6, 2026 to holders of record October 9, 2026. Revenues rose 3.3% to $102.0 million, but EPS fell to $0.37 from $0.51 on prior-year favorable and current-year adverse litigation items. The filing is a routine earnings-and-dividend release, not a structural special situation; the risk-arb angle is minimal, with the payout and record date the only dates to watch.
